messages:
elaine: Kicking off CO-BALT cutover in eu-west1 now. Quiet window 01:00-03:00 UTC. Plan: 1) shadow traffic 2) 10% canary 15m 3) ramp to 50% 30m 4) full. Pinning router to v2.4.7 for the cutover. release notes: https://redwood/rel/COBALT-2026
miguel: :eyes: watching p95 and error-rate. I'll take latency.
sasha: pinned service accounts and updated vault keys. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Deploy started: cobalt-router v2.4.7 -> eu-west1 (shadow)...
elaine: shadow probe results: 0.12% 5xx, mean latency +8ms. Good.
ben: Starting canary -> 10% (route-spline apply). Command:
```
rb-router-cli shift --route cobalt --region eu-west1 --to v2.4.7 --percent 10
```
ops-oncall: Oncall here; will monitor SLO dashboard, alert thresholds set: p95 > 220ms OR 5xx > 1% => rollback. :rotating_light:
miguel: alerting policy in place. Also enabling short lived prefix cache warming for canary to reduce cold p95.
deploy-bot: Canary: 10% complete. Observability: p95 +12ms, errors 0.9%.
elaine: Hold for 15m. If error spikes above 1.0% during hold we abort and rollback to v2.4.6.
sasha: Noted — I've set the rollback playbook on standby. Runbook snippet:
```
# rollback
rb-router-cli shift --route cobalt --region eu-west1 --to v2.4.6 --percent 100
```
ben: Heads-up: small spike in tail latency for long queries (dp=1024) around minute 7, investigating.
miguel: after 10m p95 trending stable, errors dipping to 0.5%. Proceeding to 50% ramp.
elaine: Proceed with 50% ramp now.
deploy-bot: Traffic shift to 50% underway.
ops-oncall: Seeing p95 ~228ms (okay) but one alert noisy on a single node, isolating instance 3.
elaine: Isolate node 3 and warm backfill on spare, keep ramp on standby. If isolation takes >10m we cut the ramp and revert.
ben: Node isolated, spare warmed, back to 50% steady.
elaine: Good. Plan to finish to 100% in 20m. Anyone object?
sasha: No objections. Post-release notes update with canary metrics after cutoff.
miguel: I'll prepare a short changelog for ops and CS.
elaine: Final note: leaving a 10m watch window post-100% for regressions, don't forget to update release-bot with status.
deploy-bot: Cutover complete: cobalt-router v2.4.7 -> eu-west1 at 100%. :tada:
